preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10^4.
The length of the array B is between 1 and 10^5.
Each element in B is either -1 or a non-negative integer.

preconditions.expression: The sum of N across all test cases won't exceed 2 * 10^5.
preconditions.description: The total number of elements in all arrays B across all test cases is at most 2 * 10^5.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 or (output.split() == N integers and all(0 <= int(x) <= 10^9 for x in output.split()))
postconditions.description: The output is either -1 or a line of N space-separated integers where each integer is between 0 and 10^9.

postconditions.expression: If B_i >= 0, then mex(A_1, A_2, ..., A_i) == B_i
postconditions.description: For each non-negative B_i, the mex of the constructed array A up to that point matches B_i.

postconditions.expression: If B_i == -1, then there is no constraint on mex(A_1, A_2, ..., A_i)
postconditions.description: For each -1 in B, there is no requirement on the mex of the constructed array A up to that point.

postconditions.expression: If a valid array A exists, then output the lexicographically smallest such array
postconditions.description: If there is a valid array A that satisfies the constraints, the output should be the lexicographically smallest such array.

postconditions.expression: If no valid array A exists, then output -1
postconditions.description: If there is no array A that satisfies the constraints, the output should be -1.
